1.name: John Samuel
1.verse: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

2.name: David Paul
2.verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

3.name: Samuel Raj
3.verse: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.
